question_text: Was the DoorDash outage on Nov 21 a cyberattack?
answer_text: Not established. DoorDash has not given a cause or said anything about an attack. People on social media asked if it was a hack, but no one has shown evidence of one.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: A DoorDash post-incident report with the cause, or a statement from DoorDash, a regulator or an outside investigator.
A DoorDash post-incident report or other statement naming the cause.

question_text: Did the DoorDash app and website go down on Nov 21, and for how long?
answer_text: Yes, per reports. Users saw errors from about 11 AM ET; DoorDash logged Drive errors at 11:30 and recovery at 11:50 AM ET. By 1:52 PM ET all components showed operational, but neither incident was marked resolved.
label: Reported

question_text: Is the Drive incident the same as the app and website outage?
what_would_settle_it: DoorDash saying which incident affected the app and website.

question_text: How many DoorDash customers were affected?
what_would_settle_it: DoorDash giving a figure. Downdetector counts reports, not users.
